thread:
Maya: Ran into a confusing error in the py sample today. Backend returned 429 with Retry-After but the sample just showed 'Unexpected error' and no retry CTA. New users get stuck.
Sam: That's bad. Do we know how the py client maps 429s right now?
Jordan: I checked0 min ago: transport layer currently raises a generic RequestError in py that doesn't attach headers or a stable code. Node/Go are already returning RateLimitError with retry_after.
Li: Can we standardize a flat metadata shape on exceptions? proposal: fields = ["status", "code", "retryable", "retry_after", "hint"]. Keep values simple strings/bools.
Maya: +1. Also include a short machine code like 'rate.limit_exceeded' so sample-apps can programmatically decide whether to show a banner vs. a CTA.
Sam: Implementation notes: map at transport->raise boundary so higher layers see typed exceptions. Do not coerce 4xx -> 5xx. Parse Retry-After (seconds or HTTP-date) into retry_after string.
Jordan: Tests: add small parity suite asserting status->exception class, presence of metadata keys, and that exception.__str__ is human-friendly (raw body only when RI_SDK_DEBUG=true). I'll add these to CI.
Li: UX rules for sample-app: when exception.metadata.hint exists show it as primary action text; for rate limits show countdown if retry_after present. Keep hints imperative: e.g., 'Run `ri login`' or 'Retry in 30s'.
Maya: Telemetry: tag errors with error_class (e.g., RateLimitError) and error_code so we can alert on onboarding spikes. DevBot can surface a weekly digest.
DevBot: (automated) ticket INF-5001 created: "SDK: unify exception contract + surface retry hints in sample apps" assigned to Sam.
Sam: I'll take the py work: add exceptions module, attach metadata dict (flat keys only), and update sample-app to render hint & CTA. ETA: 4 days. PR link when draft is ready.
Jordan: I'll implement parity tests for node/go and wire them into the SDK CI job.
Li: I'll update onboarding docs with copy examples and a short checklist for engineers integrating the SDK (how to handle AuthError vs RateLimitError).
Maya: Thanks. Goal: reduce ambiguous support threads and make the first-run UX actionable.
Sam: Draft PR posted: https://git.internal/redwood/py-sdk/pull/210 (draft). Pinged for reviews. :wave:
Maya: Reviewing now. If green we can canary to staging and exercise the onboarding funnel.
Jordan: Will run parity suite after staging deploy and report back here.
Maya: Nice work team.
